lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a rectilinear grid posterior to the branchial region, extending to the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, creating high-contrast anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and a shadow effect on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, faint high-luminance spots concentrated primarily along the anterior margin and the basal region of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast silhouettes representing commensal organisms clustered in the sub-pectoral and mid-ventral regions.
